limitations: Source components are conservative catalogue taxonomy; physical families, platforms and generations are not certified.
Broad source bases (including Audi RS, BMW M, MINI John Cooper Works, Fiat 500) keep different observed products together. Canonical labels are identifiers only.
Only literal normalized full-name links in the observed sample are addressed; undetected related families may remain separate.
Collection was stopped at 4500 raw records after a target-independent row budget; this is a partial catalogue snapshot.
